configurations.name: preview
runtimeArgs: npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 4173 --strictPort

configurations.name: commit
runtimeArgs: git add -A && git -c core.pager=cat commit -q -F .claude/commit-msg.txt; echo '=== LOG ==='; git -c core.pager=cat log --format='%h %an %s' -n 5; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short | head -20; npx vite preview --port 4174 --strictPort
